idea-plugin.name: Test Order Repairman
idea-plugin.description:
Renumber JUnit @Order values in source order with Alt+Enter.

Place the caret inside a JUnit Jupiter @Order annotation on a Java test method and choose Renumber JUnit @Order values in this class.

  • Assigns consecutive values starting at 1 to already annotated test methods declared directly in the selected class.
  • Keeps neighboring classes, nested classes, class annotations, extension fields, and helper methods unchanged.
  • Supports constants, expressions, negative values, parameterized tests, repeated tests, test factories, templates, and composed test annotations.
  • Preserves annotation names, imports, and values that already match their position.

This is a manually invoked intention. It does not watch edits, move methods, add missing @Order annotations, or configure JUnit's orderer. To run methods by these values, configure @TestMethodOrder(MethodOrderer.OrderAnnotation.class). The action is unavailable if the numbering already matches or an annotated test method has an invalid or unresolved order value. Expressions whose value must change are replaced with integer literals; shared constants are not modified.
